_comment: Brent crude (Europe Brent Spot Price FOB) converted to GBP. USD series sourced from EIA daily table at https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/rbrted.htm (US federal public-domain). GBP/USD spot is the BoE 4pm daily fix (XUDLUSS). Refreshed weekly by the editorial pipeline. 2026-09-01 refresh: latest EIA Europe Brent Spot print is 2026-08-25 = $88.24/bbl (FRED mirror DCOILBRENTEU; EIA publishes the dated series with a few days' lag), divided by the ingested gbp_usd 4pm fix 1.3571, giving 88.24 / 1.3571 = 65.021 -> 65.02 GBP/bbl. The triplet round-trips: 65.02 x 1.3571 = 88.24. Matches the live eia_brent observation ingested 2026-08-25. Context: Brent retraced from the 18 Aug $95.29 print as the Middle East risk premium eased, but remains well above the pre-conflict $60s.
